note: Tempdoc 600 PART IX/X — the degradation-cause reason vocabulary is ONE closed authority. The producer (StatusLifecycleHandler) emits readiness reason codes from the closed LifecycleReasonCode enum; the FE CAUSE_ROWS table words them (code -> wording/remedy/severity). This register's gate (scripts/ci/check-readiness-reason-codes.mjs) enforces producer<->consumer correspondence so neither can drift: FORWARD = every enum code that is NOT exempt has a CAUSE_ROWS row (so a user can never be shown a raw `Degraded: <code>` string in the degradation banner); BACKWARD = every CAUSE_ROWS code is a real enum member OR a declared FE-derived code (no dead/typo rows); PRODUCER (tempdoc 837 §5) = every enum code is referenced by at least one modules/**/src/main Java source outside the enum's own file, by enum NAME or quoted code string, matched AFTER comment-stripping. The two allow-lists below are the only curated artifact (the search-issuance gate's allowedReferences pattern); note that noWordingExempt does NOT exempt from the PRODUCER direction, since the two lists answer different questions (a code can legitimately never reach the banner and still need an emit site).
producerDirectionNote: Tempdoc 837 sections 4/5 and Lane F D1-15. Four ORT_CUDA_* codes lived in this vocabulary with no producer for months; the producer direction prevents that drift. The current lifecycle codes have no producer exemption. A new code requires a real emission site. The desktop-owned engine.escalated_restart is FE-derived from supervisor lastExit.reason. Tap coverage remains a separate check: a reason with an emit site and wording row can still miss a (dimension, state, code) Condition mapping.

noWordingExempt.why: NewerDataNotice publishes a non-blocking Health condition with the recorded newer versions and preserved filenames in its Java message. It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses, like settings.reset_from_corrupt.

Spec F §1.3: EngineContainmentNotice publishes a non-blocking Health condition at boot when the Engine could not join its own Windows job, with the failed call and Windows error in its Java message. It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses, like data.newer_build.

Fail-closed boot refusal (tempdoc 884 item 23): the Head throws at LocalApiServer construction before the loopback bind, so no readiness envelope, ConditionStore or SSE stream exists to carry it. The operator sees it in the fatal log line and the process exit; there is no UI to word it in.

Sticky Health ConditionStore projection of the fixed settings owner's four typed recovery causes. SettingsRecoveryNotice supplies the user-facing message; this code never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses.

Head-owned ConditionStore condition (SettingsRecoveryNotice, tempdoc 882 item 24); never on the readiness envelope, so never reaches wordCauses. The user sees it on the Health surface, which renders conditions with the Java-side message.
TELEMETRY dimension -> 'telemetry' composite, which the verdict never reads

Head-owned ConditionStore condition (OperationRecoveryNotice); the Health surface renders its Java message, including preserved bytes and the bounded retry fence. It is not a readiness-envelope cause.

It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses; the operating surface words it from its reasons.

Spec E step E3: the reasonCode of the operating status block's indexing projection (operating.indexing), set by OperatingStateAssembler when indexing is PAUSED because another application needs the graphics card's memory (the Engine's GPU residency sampler raised external pressure on the bulk work gate). It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses; the operating surface words it from its reasons.

Spec E step E4: the reasonCode of the operating status block's indexing projection (operating.indexing), set by OperatingStateAssembler when indexing is PAUSED because a game runs (the Engine's GPU residency sampler detected one and set the bulk work gate's game input). It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses; the operating surface words it from its reasons.

Spec E step E7b (P4): the reasonCode of the operating status block's user_setting_unmet degradation (operating.degradations), set by OperatingStateAssembler while an explicit user setting outranks the device-memory plan and cannot be honoured on this machine; its cause lists the unmet settings. It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses; the operating surface words it from its code.

Spec E step E7b: the reasonCode of the operating status block's device_below_p8 degradation (operating.degradations), set by OperatingStateAssembler while the pinned GPU's total memory is below the P8 boundary, so no device-memory plan applies and today's constants stay (Spec E revision 3 section 2.2, the below-P8 row). The status profile reads P8 because the profile enum has no smaller class. It never enters the readiness envelope or wordCauses.

Head-owned sticky ConditionStore degradation (OperationRecoveryNotice) for a failed durable attempt transition. Health names the operation key and intended state without exception text; not a readiness-envelope cause.

feDerived.why: The Engine exits before it can emit a lifecycle snapshot. The desktop recovery view derives this reason from the supervisor's lastExit.reason=escalated_restart observation.
Lane F B14: the desktop recovery surface derives exhaustion from the current host's supervisor event or in-memory snapshot; an unavailable Engine cannot emit it. No disk predecessor state is read.

emissionDirectionNote: Lane F stage A checkpoint. checkProducers asks whether a code is MENTIONED; checkEmissions asks whether it is PRODUCED — mentioned in a value position rather than only compared against or logged. The weaker question let two passes of a design document disagree about whether WORKER_RESTART_EXHAUSTED had a producer while this gate certified both. awaitingProducer is the declared escape hatch: a code whose producer is scheduled but unwritten stays visible and owned instead of being indistinguishable from a live one. The gate also reds when a declared entry gains a producer, so the list cannot rot into a permanent exemption.
